rules.name: Loss of adsorbed moisture and volatile solvents
rules.quote: A slight mass loss was initially observed at 110 to 150 °C due to water loss due to elevated temperature.
rules.overlap: This is one example from the review; water is often lost below 110 °C as well. Treat the range as a single observation, not a limit.

rules.name: Main decomposition of plant fibre or biomass (hemicellulose and cellulose region)
rules.quote: It can be seen that natural fibers usually degrade in three main stages with most of the thermal decomposition occurring in the range of 215 to 470 °C.
rules.overlap: Hemicellulose, cellulose and lignin overlap strongly in this range and can seldom be separated on a TGA curve alone.

rules.name: Decomposition of hemicellulose and cellulose
rules.quote: The thermal degradation of hybrid composites was discovered at 250 to 400 °C due to the decomposition of the cellulosic and hemicellulose components.
rules.overlap: Overlaps with lignin decomposition, which starts in the same region.

rules.name: Decomposition of lignin
rules.quote: [...] lignin would thermally decompose with peaks from 280 to 520 °C and up to 229 kJ/mol for activation energy [73].
rules.overlap: A broad, weak step that starts under the cellulose step and continues far above it.
